name: Signals, Stat
description: Render one pushed signal: a hero value, or a two-state beacon with your own icon per state. Publishers (Shortcuts, shell scripts, Home Assistant) PUT rows to the Companion bridge, so the widget makes no network requests and a publisher that stops reads as stale rather than as OFF.

cell_options.name: signal
cell_options.label: Signal
cell_options.help: Published signals, one per publisher's chosen id. Empty means nothing has been published yet.

cell_options.name: row_id
cell_options.label: Row within the signal
cell_options.help: Only needed when a signal carries several rows. Empty uses the first row.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Blank uses the label the publisher sent.

choices.label: Auto (beacon when ON states are set)

cell_options.name: on_values
cell_options.label: Values that count as ON
cell_options.help: Comma-separated, case-insensitive. Matched against the row's state first, then its value, so a publisher can name states (alert / ok) or just send a value.

cell_options.name: on_icon
cell_options.label: Icon when ON
cell_options.help: Phosphor icon name. Browse at phosphoricons.com.

cell_options.name: stale_after
cell_options.label: Treat as stale after (seconds)
cell_options.help: Measured against the row's own timestamp when the publisher sent one, else the snapshot's. 0 disables, which leaves only the server's own 24 h staleness and 48 h expiry.

cell_options.name: show_publisher
cell_options.label: Show which publisher sent it
cell_options.help: Useful when several machines publish the same signal id.
